info.title: BetterCollected public API
info.description:
Create, read, change and publish forms as **form spec v1** documents, and read
their responses. Authenticate with a workspace API key:
`Authorization: Bearer bc_...`. A key works in its own workspace only, with
its scopes (`forms:read`, `forms:write`, `responses:read`), and never does
more than the person who created it may do at the time of the call.

- Errors: `{"code", "message", "errors"?: [{"path", "message"}]}`; `path` is
  a JSON pointer into the request body.
- Versions: `GET /forms/{formId}` answers an `ETag`; `PUT` needs it as
  `If-Match` (428 without, 412 when stale), operations accept it.
- Retries: `Idempotency-Key` on `POST /forms`, `/ops` and `/publish`.
- Rate limits per API key and per workspace: 429 with `Retry-After`.

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or its creator lacks the permission.

post.summary: Create a draft form from a spec document
post.description: All or nothing: the whole document is checked first; any error is a 422 listing every problem, and nothing is created. A logo URL in the document is ignored (logos are uploaded). Answers 201 with the stored document, its ETag and Location.

put.summary: Replace a form from a spec document
put.description: Needs `If-Match` with the ETag from GET (428 without it, 412 when the form changed since, also when another save lands at the same moment). The document replaces the form's content; in `trust` and `logo` a key you leave out keeps its stored value ("" clears a text). Answers the stored document and its new ETag.

post.description: The operations engine the builder's AI chat and MCP use. Atomic by default: any failed operation is a 422 `ops_failed` and nothing is stored. With `atomic: false`, what applies is stored and each result says how it went. `If-Match` is optional; when given, it is enforced (412).

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: An image or video shown with a question or a choice.

Choice.title: Choice
Choice.description:
One option of a choice question. Logic conditions compare with
``value``.

fieldType.title: Fieldtype
fieldType.description: Type of the source question (filled in by the editor).

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description:
One condition of a visibility rule or a page jump: the answer of
``fieldId`` compared with ``value`` (a choice's value, "Yes"/"No" for a
yes/no question). On a repeating group, ``groupMode`` COUNT compares
the number of items; ANY / ALL test ``childFieldId`` in the items.

DateRule.title: DateRule
DateRule.description:
The chosen date must be ``comparison`` a fixed ``date`` (YYYY-MM-DD),
today, or the answer of another date question (``fieldId``).

code.title: Code

AND = all, OR = any; AND when absent).

PageJump.title: PageJump

Repeat.title: Repeat
Repeat.description: Makes a group repeatable: its questions are answered once per item.

diff.title: Diff

internalAnswers.title: Internalanswers
internalAnswers.description: Values staff entered in the form's internal fields, by field id.

Retention.title: Retention
Retention.description:
How long answers are kept: a number of days, until a date
(YYYY-MM-DD), or forever.

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: Colours and style of the form (or of one page, as an override).

imageUrl.title: Imageurl
imageUrl.description: Only images from our own storage or Unsplash are shown.

ThemeBackground.title: ThemeBackground
ThemeBackground.description: Optional decoration of the page ground.

Trust.title: Trust
Trust.description:
What respondents are told about their data, and how answers are
handled.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Not blocking: checks a publish applies, read-only values.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: The organisation's compliance rules are only checked by the AI review, never here.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: A regular expression the text answer must match.

Validations.title: Validations
Validations.description:
Answer constraints. Lengths apply to text answers, values to numbers,
choices to multiple-selection questions.
